rows.evidence: Change +25.6% in 6 months; z = 1.07 with the honest uncertainty (limit 2.39). A change above about 5% in six months is implausible for this region (teaching assumption). The twin moved only 0.9% toward it.

Stated uncertainty 4.0% is too small. A 1.1 mm alignment error on a region of radius 17.4 mm implies about 18.9% (3 x 1.1 / 17.4). We carry 18.9% forward. A rigid shift alone does not change a volume; pushing a mask through an imperfect registration does.
rows.discriminating_test: Re-register and re-segment the follow-up independently.

rows.discriminating_test: Repeat placement with auto-align; compare the voxel position on the anatomy.
